documentation.content: 5 分鐘內超過 5 個 5xx 回應。先看 Cloud Run log（severity>=ERROR）；若是剛部署造成，用 `gcloud run services update-traffic __SERVICE__ --region asia-east1 --to-revisions=<上一版>=100` 回滾。

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="__SERVICE__" AND metric.label.response_code_class="5xx"
